candidate_relations.reason: The nodular lymphocytic infiltrate with germinal centers, CD20 positivity, and BCL-2 negativity is characteristic of actinic prurigo's reactive B-cell follicles, not CTCL. Clinical context (phototest, cheilitis, pruritus) further supports actinic prurigo.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is a distinct malignant entity; biopsy here shows B-cell follicular pattern (CD20+, BCL-2-) not T-cell lymphoma

candidate_relations.reason: No muscle weakness, no heliotrope rash, no Gottron papules, ANA normal. Biopsy and phototest findings are inconsistent with dermatomyositis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Dermatomyositis involves muscle involvement, heliotrope rash, Gottron papules; none present here

candidate_relations.reason: Clinical and histological features do not match psoriasis. No silvery plaques, no Auspitz sign, biopsy shows spongiosis and B-cell nodular infiltrate.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Psoriasis presents with well-demarcated plaques, acanthosis, parakeratosis; biopsy shows spongiosis and follicular lymphoid aggregates instead

candidate_relations.reason: No acantholysis on biopsy, no autoantibodies reported, clinical picture of photosensitive prurigo with cheilitis is inconsistent with pemphigus.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pemphigus is an autoimmune blistering disorder with acantholysis; not supported by biopsy or serology here

candidate_relations.reason: Biopsy shows spongiosis and nodular lymphoid infiltrate, not acantholysis. Lip lesion is cheilitis-type fissuring, not mucosal erosions of PV. No supporting serology.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pemphigus vulgaris requires suprabasal acantholysis and mucosal involvement with characteristic antibodies; absent here

candidate_relations.reason: No follicular keratosis, no palmoplantar involvement, biopsy and phototest findings are entirely inconsistent with PRP.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pityriasis rubra pilaris presents with follicular keratosis, palmoplantar keratoderma, and characteristic histology; not present here

case_quality_flags: None of the candidates match the reference diagnosis of actinic prurigo with associated cheilitis
Reference diagnosis is strongly supported by delayed UVA phototest positivity, lower lip cheilitis sparing surrounding skin, and reactive B-cell follicular infiltrate on biopsy
